name: Skitarii
summary: Skitarii cannot be Psykers. They may only take the Skitarii Veteran class. Skitarii are cybernetically altered, doctrinally conditioned, and tied to the Machine Cult. Their identity should stay separate from psychic characters, faith- driven zealots, underhive scum, and normal Imperial soldiers.
